items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: I got it from a book from Bobby Seale who was of course the former Black Panther and later on became the professor at Temple University.

ctx.x: Yeah. And of course there’s a couple of different connections to that. Of course it’s a second line beat, which of course is from New Orleans so you can think about “Strutting with some Barbecue,” of course a little homage to Louis Armstrong. But the actual title came from, I got it from a book from Bobby Seale who was of course the former Black Panther and later on became the professor at Temple University. And for a while he became famous for his barbecue recipes. And he had a book called Q-B-Rab with Bobby…
